newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products end mostly firm, naphtha fragile.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products end mostly firm, naphtha fragile.

text.p: NWE products ended mostly stronger on Wednesday, traders said.
Gasoline firmed on NYMEX unleaded's gains and bullish stock data. Full April delivery Eurograde barges traded at $194.50.
Naphtha was fragile with a number of 10,000-15,000 parcels offered in a fairly well-covered market.
High sulphur barges traded $1-$2 higher in thin volume. A small cargo went for $76 fob. Low sulphur was dead calm.
April gas oil eased 25 cents to $162.25 a tonne. Heating oil cargo premiums were firm at around $3.50 over April.
